verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unreal has a plugin architecture that lets developers add runtime functionality, new file types, and extend Editor capabilities (unreal-docs-5, unreal-docs-13), and a community comment notes strong third-party program support (unreal-comm-11), which implies an ecosystem for ready-made add-ons. However, there is no direct evidence in this pack of an actual asset store (e.g. Marketplace/Fab) offering ready-made models, textures, or tools for purchase/download. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a marketplace/store, catalog size or scope of third-party content, and independent confirmation of asset quality/availability.
